articles.title: Minnesota Mother Charged with Second-Degree Murder in Fatal Shooting of Her Two Young Children in Savage
articles.title_so: Hooyo Soomaaliyeed oo Lagu Soo Oogay Dacwad Dil ah Ka Dib Markii Labadeeda Carruurta ah Lagu Toogtay Gobolka Minnesota
articles.summary: Prosecutors in Scott County, Minnesota, on Friday filed two counts of second-degree murder against 33-year-old Awo Abdikarin Duale following the fatal shooting of her two young children, ages 3 and 5, at their apartment in the Twin Cities suburb of Savage earlier this week.
articles.summary_so: Xeer-ilaalinta degmada Scott County ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa maanta oo Jimco ah laba dacwadood oo dil ah ku soo oogtay Cawo Cabdikariin Ducaale oo 33 jir ah, ka dib markii labadeeda carruurta ah oo da'doodu ahayd 3 iyo 5 sano jir lagu toogtay gurigooda oo ku yaalla magaalada Savage horaantii toddobaadkan.
articles.content:
A 33-year-old Minnesota woman, Awo Abdikarin Duale, was formally charged on Friday with two counts of second-degree intentional murder in connection with the shooting deaths of her two young children inside their apartment in Savage, a southern suburb of Minneapolis–St. Paul.
According to a criminal complaint filed in Scott County Court, Savage police officers responded shortly before 6:30 a.m. on Wednesday, November 18, to an apartment complex on the 4000 block of 126th Street after a 911 caller reported that she had shot her children and that they were not breathing. Responding officers immediately began life-saving aid. One child was pronounced dead at the scene, while the second child was rushed to Hennepin County Medical Center, where the child later died.
Authorities identified the victims as 5-year-old Ryder Rennie and 3-year-old Tahari Rennie. Savage Police Chief Brady Juell confirmed that Duale cooperated with officers when she was taken into custody at the scene, and noted that the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension (BCA) is assisting local investigators.
Scott County Attorney Ron Hocevar explained on Friday that second-degree intentional murder is the highest charge a county prosecutor can file under Minnesota law without convening a grand jury, which could later consider an indictment for first-degree premeditated murder. Prosecutors also noted during proceedings that Duale had been under investigation by the Minnesota Attorney General’s Office in connection with a state Medicaid fraud case.
Chief Juell described the incident as "a tragedy to this family" and "a tragedy to this community," as families across the Twin Cities diaspora mourn the loss of the two young children.
articles.content_so:
Xeer-ilaalinta degmada Scott County ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa maanta oo Jimco ah si rasmi ah ugu soo oogtay Cawo Cabdikariin Ducaale (Awo Abdikarin Duale) oo 33 jir ah laba eedeymood oo dil ah (second-degree intentional murder), ka dib markii labadeeda carruurta ah lagu dhex toogtay guri ay ka degganaayeen magaalada Savage oo dhacda koonfurta magaalooyinka mataanaha ah ee Minneapolis iyo St. Paul.
Sida ku cad gal-dacwadeedka loo gudbiyay maxkamadda degmada Scott County, ciidamada booliiska magaalada Savage ayaa aroornimadii hore ee Arbacadii, 18-ka Nofeembar, abbaare 6:30 subaxnimo u gurmaday dhisme ku yaalla waddada 126th Street, ka dib markii qof soo wacay khadka gurmadka degdegga ah ee 911 uu sheegay inay toogatay carruurteeda isla markaana aanay neefsanayn. Booliiska ayaa isla markiiba bilaabay gargaar degdeg ah, hase yeeshee mid ka mid ah carruurta ayaa isla goobta ku geeriyooday, halka ilmaha labaad loola cararay isbitaalka Hennepin County Medical Center halkaas oo uu markii dambe ku geeriyooday.
Hay'adaha ammaanka ayaa magacyada carruurta geeriyootay ku sheegay Ryder Rennie oo 5 sano jir ahaa iyo Tahari Rennie oo 3 sano jir ahaa. Taliyaha booliiska magaalada Savage, Brady Juell, ayaa sheegay in hooyadu ay la shaqeysay booliiska markii gacanta lagu dhigayay, isagoo intaas ku daray in hay’adda baarista dembiyada ee gobolka Minnesota (BCA) ay gacan ka geysanayso baaritaanka kiiskan.
Xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee degmada Scott County, Ron Hocevar, ayaa sheegay in sharciga gobolka Minnesota uu dhigayo in dacwadda ugu sarreysa ee uu xeer-ilaaliye soo oogi karo ka hor inta aan la fariisin xeer-beegti (grand jury) ay tahay dilka darajada labaad, iyadoo xeer-beegtidu ay markii dambe go'aan ka gaari karto in dacwadda loo beddelo dil darajada koowaad ah. Xeer-ilaalinta ayaa sidoo kale maxkamadda ka sheegtay in eedeysanaha uu baaritaan kaga socday xafiiska Xeer-ilaaliyaha Guud ee Minnesota kaasoo la xiriira kiis musuqmaasuq oo dhinaca caafimaadka ah (Medicaid).
Taliyaha booliiska Savage, Brady Juell, ayaa dhacdadan ku tilmaamay "masiibo ku habsatay qoyska iyo bulshada deegaanka," iyadoo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee gobolka Minnesota ay si weyn uga naxday geerida naxdinta leh ee labada carruurta ah.

articles.title: Thousands of Students and Workers Rally Across Europe Against High Living Costs, Public Service Cuts, and Rising Military Spending
articles.title_so: Kumanaan Arday iyo Shaqaale ah oo Dibadbaxyo Balaaran ka Dhigay Yurub, Iyagoo ka Cabanaya Nolol-qaaliyowga iyo Miisaaniyadda Milateriga oo la Kordhiyay
articles.summary: Coordinated demonstrations and strikes swept across more than 20 European countries on Friday, November 20, 2026, as students, trade unions, and youth activists protested surging living costs, education underfunding, and government budgets prioritizing military expenditure over public welfare.
articles.summary_so: Dibadbaxyo iyo shaqo-joojin isku xiran ayaa maanta oo Jimco ah, 20-ka Nofeembar 2026, ka dhacay in ka badan 20 dal oo Yurub ah, iyadoo ardayda, ururrada shaqaalaha, iyo dhallinyaradu ay ka soo horjeesteen qiimaha nolosha oo sare u kacay, dhimista adeegyada bulshada, iyo kordhinta kharashaadka milateriga.
articles.content:
Tens of thousands of students, workers, and youth activists took to the streets across Europe on Friday in a coordinated wave of demonstrations demanding higher wages, affordable housing, and stronger public services, while opposing increased military spending.
Inspired by months of sustained strikes and street protests in France, Friday’s rallies unfolded across major capitals and cities in Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Austria, Sweden, and Croatia. Organizers said youth-led coalitions mobilized across more than 20 countries under the banner of a "fight for our future," calling on European governments to shift spending away from defense budgets and back into schools, healthcare, and social welfare.
In Italy, a nationwide general strike called by major labor unions disrupted public and private sector services. High school and university students marched through downtown Rome and Milan alongside striking workers to protest the government’s budget bill, carrying banners demanding peace and increased investment in education.
In Germany, youth-led demonstrations drew heavy police deployments in Berlin, Frankfurt, and Hamburg, causing local transit disruptions. Similar student walkouts and street marches were held in London’s Parliament Square, across roughly a dozen cities in Croatia, and in Spain. While most rallies proceeded peacefully, heavy security forces were deployed across major European capitals amid concerns over potential clashes following weeks of unrest in France and Belgium.
articles.content_so:

Dibadbaxyadan oo ay dhiirrigeliyeen mudaaharaadyadii bilihii la soo dhaafay ruxay dalka Faransiiska, ayaa maanta ka dhacay dalal ay ka mid yihiin Talyaaniga, Jarmalka, Ingiriiska, Isbaanishka, Austria, Iswiidhan, iyo Croatia. Qabanqaabiyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in dhallinyaro ka badan 20 dal ay ku midoobeen baaqyo dowladaha Yurub looga dalbanayo inay miisaaniyadda ka soo wareejiyaan dhinaca hubka iyo dagaallada, una weeciyaan waxbarashada, caafimaadka, iyo daryeelka bulshada.
Dalka Talyaaniga, shaqo-joojin guud oo ay ku baaqeen ururrada shaqaalaha ayaa hakad gelisay adeegyada dowladda iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay, iyadoo ardayda dugsiyada sare iyo jaamacadaha ay socod ku mareen bartamaha magaalooyinka Rome iyo Milan si ay uga soo horjeestaan hindise-sharciyeedka miisaaniyadda dowladda.
Sidoo kale, magaalooyinka Berlin, Frankfurt, iyo Hamburg ee dalka Jarmalka ayaa la geeyay ciidamo booliis ah oo aad u tiro badan xilli ay dhallinyaradu dhigayeen dibadbaxyo hakiyay gaadiidka dadweynaha. Mudaaharaadyo la mid ah ayaa ka dhacay magaalada London ee dalka Ingiriiska iyo ilaa laba iyo toban magaalo oo ku yaalla Croatia. Inkastoo badi dibadbaxyadu ay ku dhaceen si nabad ah, haddana ammaanka caasimadaha Yurub ayaa si weyn loo adkeeyay ka dib rabshado toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay ka dhacay dalalka Faransiiska iyo Biljimka.

articles.title: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud Offers Unconditional Talks with Opposition at Any Venue of Their Choice, Signaling Political Maturity Amid National Unity Push
articles.title_so: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Shaaciyay inuu Diyaar u Yahay Wadahadal uu la Galo Mucaaradka Goob Kasta oo ay Doortaan, Tallaabo Muujinaysa Biseyl Siyaasadeed
articles.summary: In a decisive gesture of statesmanship on Friday, Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud declared his readiness to hold direct national dialogue with opposition leaders at any location they select, underscoring a commitment to internal reconciliation and political maturity at a critical moment for the nation's sovereignty.
articles.summary_so: Tallaabo muujinaysa biseyl siyaasadeed iyo mas'uuliyad qaran, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta oo Jimco ah caddeeyay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu wadahadal toos ah la yeesho hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka meel kasta oo ay iyagu soo xushaan.
articles.content:
President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud announced on Friday that he is prepared to meet with Somali opposition figures for comprehensive political dialogue at any venue of their choosing, removing procedural barriers to talks in a move widely viewed as a sign of political maturity and national responsibility.
Speaking in Mogadishu following a week marked by heightened regional tensions and Mogadishu’s decisive defense of national sovereignty, President Mohamud emphasized that domestic political differences must be resolved through constructive Somali-led consultation rather than external mediation or political boycotts. By granting the opposition full flexibility to name the location for the talks, the presidency signaled that preserving internal cohesion and constitutional stability takes precedence over political pride or protocol.
Observers and political analysts noted that the President’s open-door approach places the responsibility squarely on opposition leaders and dissenting regional figures to prioritize national unity. In recent weeks, opposition groups had boycotted federal dialogue sessions in Mogadishu while holding consultations abroad—a dynamic that federal officials warned could be exploited by foreign actors seeking to weaken Somalia’s central institutions.
By extending an unconditional invitation to talk on the opposition's preferred terms of venue, President Mohamud has demonstrated confidence in democratic engagement and a willingness to bridge divides peacefully. The initiative aims to forge a unified national front on key constitutional, electoral, and security priorities—reinforcing the principle that Somalia’s political future belongs exclusively in the hands of its own leaders and citizens.
articles.content_so:
Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta oo Jimco ah ku dhawaaqay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu wadahadal siyaasadeed oo buuxa la yeesho hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka goob kasta oo ay iyagu doortaan, isagoo meesha ka saaray caqabad kasta oo ku saabsan hannaanka shirarka, taasoo loo arkay calaamad muujinaysa biseyl siyaasadeed iyo hoggaamin xilkasnimo leh.
Hadalkan oo ku soo beegmay xilli ay dowladda federaalku waddo dadaallo adag oo lagu difaacayo madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada qaranka, ayuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku adkeeyay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee gudaha lagu xalliyo wadahadal ay Soomaalidu leedahay, halkii loo kala bixi lahaa dibadda ama la qaadici lahaa shirarka qaran. In mucaaradka loo daayo doorashada goobta lagu shirayo waxay muujinaysaa in madaxtooyadu ay mudnaanta koowaad siinayso wadajirka ummadda iyo xasilloonida dalka.
Falanqeeyayaasha siyaasadda ayaa tilmaamay in gacanta furan ee uu Madaxweynuhu u fidiyay mucaaradka ay imtixaan u tahay dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda si ay u muujiyaan waddaniyad iyo tanaasul. Todobaadyadii u dambeeyay, qaar ka mid ah mucaaradka ayaa ka maqnaa shirarkii wadatashiga ee Muqdisho, taasoo mas'uuliyiinta dowladdu ay ka digeen inay fursad siin karto faragelin shisheeye oo lagu kala qaybinayo dalka.
Go’aanka Madaxweynaha ee ah in wadahadal lagu qabto goob kasta oo ay mucaaradku ku qanacsan yihiin wuxuu xoojinayaa kalsoonida hannaanka dimuqraadiga ah, wuxuuna albaabka u furayaa mideynta aragtiyaha ku saabsan amniga, dastuurka, iyo horumarka dalka—si masiirka Soomaaliya uu ugu jiro gacanta dadkeeda.

articles.title: Vigilance Is Survival: Somalia Must Mobilize Every Resource to Defend Its Sovereignty Before External Meddling Replicates the Tragedies of Yemen, Libya, and Sudan
articles.title_so: Feejignaan Waa Badbaado: Soomaaliya Waa Inay Adeegsataa Awood Kasta oo ay Leedahay si ay Isaga Difaacdo Khatarta Muuqata ee Imaaraadka Ka Hor Inta Aanay Dalka Ka Dhigin Sidii Yemen, Liibiya, iyo Suudaan
articles.summary: Following Mogadishu’s decisive expulsion of the UAE ambassador, Somalia stands at a defining historical crossroads—requiring total national vigilance, institutional unity, and every legal, diplomatic, and security tool at its disposal to prevent foreign interference from fracturing the nation into the same cycle of devastation seen in Yemen, Libya, and Sudan.
articles.summary_so: Ka dib go’aankii geesinimada lahaa ee Muqdisho ay dalka uga cayrisay safiirkii Imaaraadka Carabta, Soomaaliya waxay taagan tahay isgoys taariikhi ah oo u baahan feejignaan buuxda, midnimo qaran, iyo adeegsiga awood kasta oo sharci, diblomaasiyadeed, iyo amni ah si looga hortago faragelin shisheeye oo dalka u horseedda burburkii ku dhacay Yemen, Liibiya, iyo Suudaan.
articles.content:
Somalia’s decision on Thursday to expel the United Arab Emirates' ambassador within 72 hours and recall its own envoy from Abu Dhabi is more than a diplomatic protest—it is an urgent act of national self-defense. For a nation that has spent decades clawing its way back from state collapse, the warning signs across the region could not be clearer: external powers that bypass legitimate central governments, bankroll proxy militias, and carve up strategic ports leave behind only fractured states, endless bloodshed, and economic ruin.
As President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud warned the nation earlier this week, the blueprint of foreign-fueled fragmentation is already written across the map of the Middle East and North Africa. Libya, once a unified state, was torn into rival fiefdoms by outside patrons arming competing factions. Yemen, directly across the Gulf of Aden, remains shattered by proxy wars and separatist agendas that have plunged millions into humanitarian catastrophe. And in Sudan, external interference has fueled a brutal conflict that has displaced millions and leveled entire cities. Somalia cannot—and must not—allow itself to become the next chapter in that tragedy.
The danger confronting Somalia is neither distant nor theoretical; it is a clear and present threat to the country’s hard-won peace, constitutional order, and economic revival. When foreign actors construct unauthorized military installations on Somali soil, arm parallel paramilitary forces outside federal command, and strike unilateral port deals in Berbera, Bosaso, and Kismayo behind Mogadishu’s back, they are not investing in Somalia’s prosperity—they are erecting obstacles to its statehood. A house divided against itself cannot stand, and a nation whose ports, airspace, and political loyalties are auctioned off to foreign bidders can never achieve lasting security.
To defeat this threat before it takes deeper root, Somalia must remain ever vigilant and deploy every legitimate instrument at its disposal:
Full Enforcement of Airspace, Maritime, and Border Sovereignty: Following the annulment of unauthorized port and defense agreements and the ban on unauthorized foreign military and cargo flights, Somali security and aviation authorities must rigorously monitor and enforce national jurisdiction across every port, runway, and coastline.
Unified Constitutional Front: Federal institutions, regional leaders, parliamentarians, and traditional elders must close ranks behind the supremacy of the Somali Constitution. External interference thrives only when domestic political rivalries provide an open door; denying foreign patrons local proxies is the strongest shield Somalia possesses.
Legal Accountability and Counter-Subversion: As Cabinet and defense officials have emphasized, authorities must use every legal mechanism to dismantle illicit financing networks, halt unauthorized militia recruitment, and hold accountable any actor working to subvert the state from within.
Strategic Regional and International Diplomacy: Mogadishu must continue rallying principled allies across the Horn of Africa, the African Union, the Arab League, and the broader international community to uphold the non-negotiable principles of territorial integrity and non-interference.
Somalia’s resilience has been tested by terrorism, drought, and decades of upheaval, yet the Somali people have consistently chosen recovery over ruin. Guarding that progress today requires unwavering courage and total alertness. By standing united and defending its sovereignty without compromise, Somalia will ensure its future is written by its own citizens—not dictated by foreign powers whose footsteps elsewhere have left only division and destruction.
articles.content_so:
Go’aanka ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku amartay in safiirka Imaaraadka Carabta uu dalka uga baxo 72 saacadood gudahood, isla markaana ay ugu yeertay safiirkeedii Abu Dhabi, ma aha oo keliya tallaabo diblomaasiyadeed—waa difaac qaran oo lagama maarmaan ah. Dal tobannaan sano u soo halgamay dib-u-dhiska dowladnimadiisa, casharrada ka muuqda gobolka waa kuwo cad: awoodaha shisheeye ee baal-mara dowladaha dhexe, hubeeya maleeshiyaadka, isla markaana booba dekedaha istiraatiijiga ah, waxay dalalkaas u horseedaan oo keliya kala qaybsanaan, dhiig daata, iyo burbur dhaqaale.
Sida uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud toddobaadkan uga digay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, raadadka burburka ee ka dhashay faragelinta shisheeye waxay si cad uga muuqdaan khariidadda Bariga Dhexe iyo Waqooyiga Afrika. Liibiya waxaa loo kala qaybiyay maamullo iska soo horjeeda ka dib markii la hubeeyay kooxo gudaha ah. Yemen oo naga xigta dhanka Gacanka Cadan waxay ku burburtay dagaallo wakiillo ah iyo kala-qaybin dadka dhaxalsiisay masiibo bini'aadantinimo. Suudaan-na faragelinta dibadda ayaa ka hurisay colaad ba’an oo barakicisay malaayiin qof, magaalooyin dhan-na dhulka la sintay. Soomaaliya ma aqbali karto—mana ogolaan doonto—inay noqoto dhibbanaha xiga ee masiibadaas.
Khatarta ku soo wajahan Soomaaliya ma aha mid fog, ee waa khatar taagan oo caqabad ku ah nabadda, xasilloonida, iyo horumarka dalka. Marka dal shisheeye uu gudaha Soomaaliya ka dhiso saldhigyo milateri oo sharci-darro ah, uu hubeeyo maleeshiyaad ka baxsan taliska ciidamada qaranka, isla markaana uu heshiisyo deked ah la galo maamullo goboleed isagoo baal-maraya Muqdisho, taasi ma aha maalgashi lagu horumarinayo Soomaaliya—waa qorshe lagu wiiqayo jiritaanka qarannimada.
Si looga hortago khatartan ka hor inta aanay xididdo yeelan, Soomaaliya waa inay ahaataa mid had iyo jeer feejigan, isla markaana adeegsataa wax kasta oo awooddeeda ah:
Ilaalinta Buuxda ee Hawada, Badda, iyo Xuduudaha: Ka dib laalista heshiisyadii sharci-darrada ahaa iyo xayiraadda diyaaradaha milateri iyo kuwa xamuulka ee aan fasaxa haysan, hay'adaha amniga iyo duulista Soomaaliya waa inay si adag u sugaan maamulka deked kasta, garoon kasta, iyo xeeb kasta oo dalka ka tirsan.
Midnimada Dastuuriga ah ee Gudaha: Hay’adaha federaalka, madaxda maamul-goboleedyada, baarlamaanka, iyo odayaasha dhaqanka waa inay u midoobaan ilaalinta sarreynta Dastuurka. Faragelinta shisheeye waxay fursad heshaa oo keliya marka khilaafka gudaha uu albaabka u furo; in laga hortago wakiillo gudaha ah waa gaashaanka ugu adag ee qaranku leeyahay.
La-xisaabtanka Sharciga iyo Ka-hortagga Hagardaamada: Waa in la adeegsadaa dhammaan awoodaha sharciga ah si loo joojiyo dhaqaalaha sharci-darrada ah, hubaynta maleeshiyaadka, iyo cid kasta oo gudaha dalka kala shaqaynaysa qorshayaal lagu wiiqayo amniga qaranka.
Diblomaasiyad Goboleed iyo Mid Caalami ah: Muqdisho waa inay sii waddaa abaabulka saaxiibbada gobolka, Midowga Afrika, Jaamacadda Carabta, iyo beesha caalamka si loo ixtiraamo madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya.
Adkeysiga shacabka Soomaaliyeed wuxuu ka soo gudbay argagixiso, abaaro, iyo duruufo adag, had iyo jeerna wuxuu doortay dib-u-dhis iyo dowladnimo. Difaaca qarannimada maanta wuxuu u baahan yahay geesinimo aan leex-leexad lahayn iyo feejignaan joogto ah. Marka ay Soomaaliya u midowdo ilaalinta midnimadeeda, waxay xaqiijinaysaa in mustaqbalkeeda ay go'aamiyaan muwaadiniinteeda—ee aanay gacanta u gelin awoodo shisheeye oo meel kasta oo ay cagta dhigaan ka tagay dhimasho, burbur, iyo kala qaybsanaan.

articles.title: Somalia Severs Diplomatic Ties with UAE, Expels Emirati Ambassador Within 72 Hours Over "Blatant Aggression" and Sovereignty Violations
articles.title_so: Soomaaliya oo Xiriirka Diblomaasiyadeed u Jartay Imaaraadka Carabta, Amartayna in Safiirka Abu Dhabi Dalka Uga Baxo 72 Saacadood Gudahood
articles.summary: The Federal Government of Somalia on Thursday recalled its ambassador from Abu Dhabi and ordered the United Arab Emirates' envoy to leave Mogadishu within 72 hours, marking a historic diplomatic rupture following cabinet accusations of "blatant aggression" and persistent interference in Somalia’s internal affairs.
articles.summary_so: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta oo Khamiis ah u yeeray safiirkii Soomaaliya u fadhiyay Abu Dhabi, isla markaana amray in safiirka Imaaraadka Carabta uu dalka uga baxo 72 saacadood gudahood, ka dib markii lagu eedeeyay "gardarro qaawan" iyo ku xad-gudubka qarannimada dalka.
articles.content:
The Federal Government of Somalia formally severed diplomatic representation with the United Arab Emirates on Thursday, ordering the Emirati ambassador to depart the country within 72 hours and recalling Somalia’s top diplomat from Abu Dhabi.
Announcing the decision following an emergency cabinet session in Mogadishu, Minister of Information Abdulfatah Qasim stated that the Council of Ministers instructed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation to take immediate diplomatic action in response to what it described as "blatant aggression" and an "open invasion" of Somalia's sovereignty.
"The Somali government is taking a series of measures to defend the country against UAE actions targeting its sovereignty, territorial integrity, national unity, internal security, and independence," Minister Qasim declared, calling on Somali citizens and community leaders to stand united in defense of the nation.
The rupture comes on the heels of escalating warnings from Mogadishu throughout the week. In a televised address on Tuesday, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud accused Abu Dhabi of constructing unauthorized military facilities on Somali soil, arming militias outside federal command, and striking port and security deals with regional administrations in Berbera, Bosaso, and Kismayo without federal consent. Defense Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi followed on Wednesday by demanding that UAE-backed armed groups be designated as terrorist organizations, while the Foreign Ministry reaffirmed that the Federal Government is the sole constitutional authority empowered to conduct Somalia's foreign relations.
Relations between Mogadishu and Abu Dhabi had deteriorated steadily since January 2026, when Somalia’s cabinet annulled all bilateral security, defense, and port cooperation agreements with the UAE and restricted Emirati military and cargo aircraft from Somali airspace—measures that were rejected by regional authorities in Somaliland, Puntland, and Jubaland.
By expelling the UAE envoy and recalling its own ambassador, Mogadishu has drawn a decisive line against parallel security arrangements and foreign deals that bypass federal institutions, signaling that Somalia will no longer tolerate external actions that compromise its unity and statehood.
articles.content_so:
Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta oo Khamiis ah si rasmi ah u jartay matalaaddii diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la lahayd Imaaraadka Carabta, iyadoo amartay in safiirka Imaaraadka u fadhiya Muqdisho uu dalka uga baxo 72 saacadood gudahood, isla markaana dib ugu yeertay safiirkii Soomaaliya ee Abu Dhabi.
Go’aankan oo ka soo baxay shir degdeg ah oo ay yeesheen Golaha Wasiirrada, ayaa waxaa warbaahinta u akhriyay Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Cabdifataax Qaasim, kaasoo sheegay in goluhu uu faray Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah inay qaaddo tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo looga jawaabayo waxa uu ku tilmaamay "gardarro qaawan" iyo faragelin toos ah oo lagu hayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya.
"Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay qaadaysaa tallaabooyin is-daba-joog ah oo dalka looga difaacayo ficillada Imaaraadka ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo madax-bannaanida, midnimada dhuleed, wadajirka qaranka, amniga gudaha, iyo gobonnimada Soomaaliya," ayuu yiri Wasiir Qaasim, isagoo ugu baaqay shacabka iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada inay u midoobaan difaaca dalkooda.
Tallaabadan taariikhiga ah ayaa ku soo beegmaysa ka dib digniino kulul oo todobaadkan ka soo baxay Muqdisho. Khudbad uu Talaadadii jeediyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayuu ku eedeeyay Abu Dhabi inay dhisayso saldhigyo milateri oo sharci-darro ah, inay hubaynayso maleeshiyaad ka baxsan taliska qaranka, isla markaana ay heshiisyo deked iyo amni la gashay maamul-goboleedyo iyadoo baal-maraysa Dowladda Federaalka. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale Arbacadii ku baaqay in kooxaha hubaysan ee Imaaraadku taageero loo aqoonsado argagixiso.
Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi ayaa sii xumaanayay tan iyo bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan 2026, markaas oo Dowladda Federaalku ay laashay dhammaan heshiisyadii amniga, difaaca, iyo dekedaha ee ay kula jirtay Imaaraadka, ayna xayiraad ku soo rogtay diyaaradaha milateri iyo kuwa xamuulka ee Imaaraadka ee isticmaala hawada Soomaaliya.
Go’aanka maanta lagu cayriyay safiirka Imaaraadka ayaa muujinaya mowqifka adag ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku difaacayso hay’adaheeda dastuuriga ah, iyadoo caddeysay inaan la aqbali karin heshiisyo garab-maraya Muqdisho ama wax u dhimaya midnimada iyo qarannimada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

articles.title: Somalia and UAE Trade Sharp Rebuke as Defense Minister Fiqi Accuses Abu Dhabi of Fueling Conflicts and Profiting from Regional Tragedies
articles.title_so: Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta oo Hadallo Kulul Is-Waydaarsaday, Wasiir Fiqi oo Abu Dhabi Ku Eedeeyay Hurinta Colaado iyo Ka Ganacsiga Masiibooyinka Shucuubta
articles.summary: Diplomatic tensions between Mogadishu and Abu Dhabi escalated sharply on Wednesday as Somali Defense Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi accused the United Arab Emirates of undermining Somalia's sovereignty and arming militias, prompting an immediate rebuttal from UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash.
articles.summary_so: Xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeysa Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi ayaa maanta oo Arbaco ah cirka isku sii shareertay ka dib markii Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, uu ku eedeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta wiiqidda qarannimada iyo hubaynta maleeshiyaad, taasoo keentay jawaab degdeg ah oo ka timid lataliyaha madaxweynaha Imaaraadka, Anwar Gargash.
articles.content:
Somalia and the United Arab Emirates traded pointed diplomatic statements on Wednesday, deepening a rift triggered by Mogadishu's accusations of Emirati interference in Somalia’s internal affairs.
Somali Defense Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi accused Abu Dhabi of fueling regional conflicts, buying political loyalties, and "profiting from the tragedies of peoples." Expanding on Tuesday's televised address by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud—who alleged that the UAE was constructing unauthorized military bases and seeking to fragment Somalia—Fiqi called on Somali authorities to formally designate UAE-armed militias as terrorist organizations.
Minister Fiqi also demanded the prosecution of Somali opposition politicians whom he accused of conspiring with Abu Dhabi against the state, and urged authorities to revoke the licenses of Mogadishu radio stations he alleged were established by or operating on behalf of the UAE. Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs reinforced the government's stance on Wednesday, insisting that all foreign engagements must be conducted exclusively through federal institutions in Mogadishu.
Abu Dhabi swiftly rejected the accusations. Dr. Anwar Gargash, diplomatic adviser to the UAE President, criticized Mogadishu's remarks, stating that President Mohamud's position reflected shifting political calculations rather than national interest. Gargash added that the UAE’s relationship with the Somali people remains "deeper and more enduring than transient political disagreements, personal calculations, or individual political ambitions," while reiterating Abu Dhabi’s stated support for Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity.
articles.content_so:
Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa maanta oo Arbaco ah is-waydaarsaday eedaymo diblomaasiyadeed oo kulul, taasoo sii xoojisay khilaafka ka dhashay eedaymaha Muqdisho ee ku saabsan faragelinta arrimaha gudaha ee Soomaaliya.
Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa ku eedeeyay Abu Dhabi inay hurinayso colaadaha gobolka, inay iibsanayso daacadnimada siyaasiyiinta, isla markaana ay "ka macaashayso masiibooyinka shucuubta." Isagoo sii xoojinaya khudbaddii Talaadadii ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud—kaasoo ku eedeeyay Imaaraadka dhismaha saldhigyo milateri oo sharci-darro ah—wuxuu Wasiir Fiqi ku baaqay in maleeshiyaadka uu sheegay in Imaaraadku hubeeyo lagu daro liiska kooxaha argagixisada.
Wasiir Fiqi wuxuu sidoo kale dalbaday in maxkamad la soo taago siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah oo uu ku eedeeyay inay la shaqaynayaan Abu Dhabi, wuxuuna hay'adaha dowladda ugu baaqay inay xiraan oo ay ruqsadda kala noqdaan idaacado ku yaalla Muqdisho oo uu ku eedeeyay inay u adeegaan danaha Imaaraadka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda maanta soo saartay bayaan ay ku adkaynayso in xiriir kasta oo dibadda ah uu soo maro Dowladda Federaalka.
Dhinaca kale, Abu Dhabi ayaa si degdeg ah isaga fogaysay eedaymahaas. Dr. Anwar Gargash, oo ah lataliyaha diblomaasiyadeed ee Madaxweynaha Imaaraadka Carabta, ayaa dhaliilay hadallada ka soo yeeray Muqdisho, isagoo sheegay in mowqifka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu muujinayo isbed-beddel siyaasadeed iyo xisaabtan shakhsi ah. Gargash wuxuu intaas ku daray in xiriirka Imaaraadku la leeyahay shacabka Soomaaliyeed uu yahay mid "ka qoto dheer kana waara khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee ku-meel-gaarka ah iyo hamiga shakhsi ahaaneed," isagoo ku celiyay in Abu Dhabi ay taageersan tahay madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya.

articles.title: Somali President Accuses UAE of Serious Internal Interference, Building Unauthorized Military Bases, and Undermining State Unity
articles.title_so: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo Ku Eedeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta Faragelin Halis ah, Dhismaha Saldhigyo Sharci-darro ah, iyo Wiiqidda Midnimada Qaranka
articles.summary: In a sharply worded address on Tuesday, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud accused the United Arab Emirates of undermining Somalia’s national unity by backing armed militias, constructing unauthorized military bases, and attempting to replicate the fragmentation seen in Libya and Yemen inside Somalia and Sudan.
articles.summary_so: Khudbad kulul oo uu jeediyay maanta oo Talaado ah, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ku eedeeyay Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta inay wiiqayso midnimada qaranka Soomaaliyeed iyadoo hubaynaysa maleeshiyaad, dhisaysa saldhigyo milateri oo aan fasax loo haysan, isla markaana doonaysa inay Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan ka dhigto sidii Liibiya iyo Yemen.
articles.content:
Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud sharply escalated Mogadishu’s diplomatic pushback against Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, accusing the United Arab Emirates of serious interference in Somalia’s internal affairs and directly undermining the unity and sovereignty of the Somali state.
In a video address released by his office, President Mohamud alleged that the UAE is constructing unauthorized military bases on Somali soil, arming rival militias and proxy units outside federal command, and encouraging the secession of Somaliland. Drawing a stark regional comparison, the President accused Abu Dhabi of exporting instability across the Horn of Africa and the broader Middle East.
"It went to Yemen and returned from Yemen divided. It now seeks to do the same to Somalia and Sudan," President Mohamud declared, referencing Libya and Yemen as examples of countries fractured by external meddling.
The remarks mark the sharpest public rebuke yet since the Federal Government announced in January 2026 the cancellation of all security, defense, and port cooperation agreements with the UAE—including arrangements involving Berbera, Bosaso, and Kismayo—citing violations of national sovereignty. Tensions have intensified further in recent weeks amid reports of Somali opposition figures and dissenting regional leaders holding coordination meetings in Abu Dhabi while boycotting federal national dialogue efforts in Mogadishu.
Despite the forceful criticism, President Mohamud reiterated that Somalia remains open to diplomatic relations with the UAE strictly on the basis of mutual respect, equality, and non-interference—stressing firmly that Somalia’s territory and national sovereignty are not for sale.
articles.content_so:
Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta oo Talaado ah si kulul ugu eedeeyay Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta inay faragelin halis ah ku hayso arrimaha gudaha ee Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay si toos ah u wiiqayso midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida qaranka.
Fariin muuqaal ah oo ka soo baxday xafiiskiisa, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh wuxuu ku eedeeyay Abu Dhabi inay gudaha Soomaaliya ka dhisayso saldhigyo milateri oo sharci-darro ah, inay hubaynayso kooxo iyo maleeshiyaad ka baxsan taliska ciidamada qaranka, isla markaana ay dhiirrigelinayso gooni-u-goosadka Somaliland. Isagoo tusaale u soo qaatay xaaladda gobolka, Madaxweynuhu wuxuu sheegay in Imaaraadku uu kala qaybiyay dalal dhowr ah.
"Waxay aadday Yemen, waxayna ka soo noqotay iyadoo Yemen kala qaybsan tahay. Hadda waxay doonaysaa inay sidaas oo kale ku samayso Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan," ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isagoo sidoo kale xusay burburkii iyo kala qaybsanaantii ka dhacday Liibiya.
Hadalkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan 2026 laashay dhammaan heshiisyadii amniga, difaaca, iyo dekedaha ee ay kula jirtay Imaaraadka Carabta—oo ay ku jireen heshiisyada dekedaha Berbera, Boosaaso, iyo Kismaayo—ka dib markii lagu eedeeyay ku xad-gudubka qarannimada dalka. Xiisadda labada dal ayaa sii korortay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ka dib markii warar ay sheegeen in hoggaamiyeyaal mucaarad ah iyo madaxda qaar ka mid ah maamul-goboleedyada ay kulamo siyaasadeed ku yeesheen magaalada Abu Dhabi.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh wuxuu mar kale ku celiyay in Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo ku dhisan is-ixtiraam iyo sinnaan, balse wuxuu si adag u carrabka ugu adkeeyay in dhulka iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya aanay ahayn wax iib ah.

articles.title: Houthi Forces Close Within 60 Kilometers of Aden After Government Pullback Near Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Putting Thousands of Somali Refugees at Risk
articles.title_so: Xoogagga Xuutiyiinta oo 60 Kiiloomitir u Soo Jirsaday Magaalada Cadan Ka Dib Dib-u-Gurashada Ciidamada Dowladda, Khatar Soo Food Saartay Qaxooti Soomaaliyeed
articles.summary: Iran-aligned Houthi fighters have seized more than 150 kilometers of evacuated Red Sea coastline and advanced to within 60 kilometers of Aden—the temporary seat of Yemen’s Saudi-backed government—sparking heightened alarm over Red Sea maritime security and the safety of thousands of refugees caught near the Lahj frontlines.
articles.summary_so: Dagaalyahannada Xuutiyiinta ayaa la wareegay in ka badan 150 kiiloomitir oo ka mid ah xeebta Badda Cas, waxayna ku soo dhawaadeen ilaa 60 kiiloomitir magaalada Cadan, taasoo walaac xooggan ka dhalisay amniga marinka Bab el-Mandeb iyo badbaadada kumanaan qaxooti Soomaaliyeed ah oo ku sugan gobolka Lahj.
articles.content:
Houthi forces have made major territorial advances in southern Yemen, closing to within roughly 60 kilometers (37 miles) of the port city of Aden following a strategic withdrawal by Yemen’s Saudi-backed forces from areas bordering the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
On Sunday, Yemen’s Southern Armed Forces announced they were redeploying troops from coastal positions near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and Dhubab Airport to reinforce defenses around Aden and nearby provinces, while continuing efforts to break the weeks-long Houthi siege on the highland city of Taiz. Ahead of potential further advances, government troops began digging defensive tunnels and erecting sandbag fortifications on the outskirts of Aden.
Houthi military sources confirmed that their fighters rapidly deployed across more than 150 kilometers of evacuated coastline stretching from Dhubab toward Khor Amira. Advancing along the coast of Lahj province, Houthi forces seized the Al-Maqatirah and Al-Madaribah districts—reaching the Al-Kharaz military camp and cutting off the main mountainous highway linking Aden to Taiz.
The rapid shift on the ground has solidified Houthi control over the eastern shore of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the narrow maritime chokepoint connecting the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean. Analysts warn that tightening Houthi control along the strait—coupled with ongoing regional maritime disruptions—poses a severe threat to global shipping lanes and Red Sea stability directly across the water from Somalia and Djibouti.
Meanwhile, humanitarian agencies have raised urgent alarms over civilians trapped near the advancing frontlines. The United Nations refugee agency (UNHCR) stated it is gravely concerned by reports of clashes around the Kharaz refugee camp in Lahj province, warning that roughly 9,600 refugees—a large majority of whom are Somali and Ethiopian nationals—are in immediate danger as fighting escalates.
articles.content_so:
Xoogagga Xuutiyiinta ee dalka Yemen ayaa guulo waaweyn oo dhanka dhulka ah ka gaaray koonfurta dalkaas, iyagoo u soo jirsaday qiyaastii 60 kiiloomitir magaalada dekadda leh ee Cadan oo ah xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dowladda Yemen ee uu Sacuudigu taageero, ka dib markii ciidamada dowladdu ay ka soo baxeen fariisimo muhiim ah oo ku dhow marinka Bab el-Mandeb.
Ciidamada Koonfurta Yemen ayaa Axaddii shaaciyay inay dib-u-habayn ku sameeyeen ciidamadooda ku sugnaa aagga Bab el-Mandeb iyo garoonka diyaaradaha ee Dhubab, si ay u xoojiyaan difaaca magaalada Cadan iyo gobollada ku dhow, isla markaana ay u qaadaan howlgallo lagu jabinayo go’doonka ay Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan magaalada Taiz. Saraakiisha ciidamada ayaa sheegay in difaacyo adag iyo godad laga qoday duleedka Cadan si looga hortago weerar kasta oo ku soo wajahan magaalada.
Ilo milateri oo ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ayaa xaqiijiyay in ciidamadoodu ay si degdeg ah u buuxiyeen in ka badan 150 kiiloomitir oo xeebta Badda Cas ah oo u dhexeysa Dhubab iyo Khor Amira. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale la wareegeen degmooyinka Al-Maqatirah iyo Al-Madaribah ee gobolka Lahj, iyagoo gaaray xerada milateri ee Al-Kharaz isla markaana gooyay waddada weyn ee buuraleyda ah ee isku xirta Cadan iyo Taiz.
Isbeddelkan milateri ayaa sii xoojiyay gacan-ku-haynta Xuutiyiinta ee marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab el-Mandeb oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadan, taasoo khatar toos ah ku ah isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah iyo amniga gobolka Geeska Afrika.
Dhanka kale, Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Qaxootiga (UNHCR) ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujisay dagaallada ka socda agagaarka xerada qaxootiga ee Kharaz ee gobolka Lahj, iyadoo ka digtay in ilaa 9,600 oo qaxooti ah—kuwaas oo u badan qaxooti Soomaaliyeed iyo Itoobiyaan—ay halis ugu jiraan colaadaha sii fidaya.

articles.title: Ethiopia and Sudan Trade Accusations of Arming Rebels as Diplomatic Expulsions Spark Fears of Wider Horn of Africa Conflict
articles.title_so: Itoobiya iyo Suudaan oo Is-Ku-Eedeeyay Hubaynta Jabhado, Xiisadda Diblomaasiyadeed oo Cabsi Ka Dhalisay Geeska Afrika
articles.summary: Escalating mutual allegations of cross-border proxy warfare between Ethiopia and Sudan—accompanied by reciprocal consulate closures and diplomat expulsions—have heightened fears that internal wars in both nations could merge into a broader regional conflagration across the Horn of Africa.
articles.summary_so: Eedaymaha is-dhaafsiga ah ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Suudaan ee ku saabsan taageeridda kooxo hubaysan—oo ay weheliso xiritaanka qunsuliyado iyo cayrinta diblomaasiyiin—ayaa kordhiyay cabsida laga qabo in colaadaha gudaha ee labada dal ay isku beddelaan dagaal goboleed oo ballaaran.
articles.content:
Tensions between neighbors Ethiopia and Sudan have reached a dangerous flashpoint after both governments traded sharp accusations of arming and harboring rebel movements operating inside each other’s borders. While both Addis Ababa and Khartoum deny the allegations, the dispute has already triggered tit-for-tat diplomatic expulsions and raised alarm among regional observers.
Earlier this month, Sudan’s military-aligned authorities lodged formal complaints with the United Nations Security Council and the African Union Peace and Security Council, accusing Ethiopia of providing training camps, logistical backing, and launch sites for the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Khartoum alleged that one-way explosive drone attacks launched from Ethiopian territory have struck Sudanese civilian areas and critical power infrastructure, resulting in hundreds of casualties.
Ethiopia rejected the claims and countered with allegations of its own, accusing Sudan—alongside Eritrea and Egypt—of backing Tigrayan rebels fighting federal forces in northern Ethiopia, where renewed clashes in September shattered the 2022 peace agreement.
The war of words quickly spilled into diplomatic retaliation. Following Sudan’s complaints to the U.N. and AU, Ethiopia closed the Sudanese consulate in the western border town of Asosa and expelled six Sudanese consular officials within 48 hours. Khartoum responded in kind by ordering the closure of Ethiopia’s consulate in Gedaref and expelling Ethiopian diplomats.
Regional analysts warn that the escalating blame game—layered atop unresolved disputes over the contested Al-Fashaga borderland, Nile water rights, and deteriorating ties between Ethiopia and Eritrea—creates severe risk that separate internal conflicts could interlock into a wider regional crisis. For Somalia and the broader Horn of Africa, the standoff underscores how cross-border proxy meddling continues to destabilize neighboring states and undermine collective regional security.
articles.content_so:
Xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dal ee deriska ah ee Itoobiya iyo Suudaan ayaa gaartay heerkii ugu sarreeyay ka dib markii labada dowladood ay si kulul isugu eedeeyeen hubaynta iyo hoy-siinta jabhado ka dagaallama gudaha dalalkooda. Inkastoo Addis Ababa iyo Khartoum ay labaduba beeniyeen eedaymahaas, khilaafku wuxuu hore u sababay tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed oo aargoosi ah, taasoo walaac ku abuurtay gobolka.
Horraantii bishan, dowladda Suudaan ayaa cabashooyin rasmi ah u gudbisay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika, iyadoo ku eedaysay Itoobiya inay saldhigyo tababar, saanad, iyo goobo laga soo rido diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) siiso ciidamada gurmadka degdegga ah ee RSF. Khartoum waxay sheegtay in weerarro diyaaradahaas ah oo laga soo qaaday dhulka Itoobiya ay burburiyeen goobo rayid ah iyo xarumo koronto, ayna ku dhinteen kuna dhaawacmeen boqollaal qof.
Dhinaca kale, Itoobiya ayaa iska fogaysay eedaymahaas, waxayna Suudaan—iyo sidoo kale Eriteriya iyo Masar—ku eedaysay inay taageero siiyaan xoogagga Tigrayga ee la dagaallamaya ciidamada federaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya, halkaas oo dagaallo cusub oo dib uga qarxay bishii Sebtembar ay burburiyeen heshiiskii nabadda ee 2022.
Khilaafkan ayaa si degdeg ah ugu fiday xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. Itoobiya ayaa xirtay qunsuliyaddii Suudaan ee magaalada xuduudda ku taal ee Asosa, waxayna 48 saacadood gudahood dalka uga cayrisay lix diblomaasi oo Suudaani ah. Suudaan ayaa dhankeeda kaga jawaabtay inay xirtay qunsuliyaddii Itoobiya ee magaalada Gedaref, kana cayrisay diblomaasiyiin Itoobiyaan ah.
Falanqeeyayaasha gobolka ayaa ka digaya in loolankan wakiillada hubaysan lagu adeegsanayo—oo ku soo beegmay xilli ay taagan yihiin khilaafaad ku saabsan xuduudda Al-Fashaga, biyaha webiga Niil, iyo xiisadda u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eriteriya—uu halis ugu jiro inuu isku xiro colaadaha ka taagan Geeska Afrika. Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan gobolka, dhacdadani waxay mar kale muujinaysaa sida faragelinta shisheeye iyo taageeridda kooxaha hubaysan ay u wiiqayaan xasilloonida iyo madax-bannaanida dalalka gobolka.

articles.title: Somali President Warns Israel and Taiwan Pose Direct Threat to Somalia’s Existence and Statehood
articles.title_so: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo Ka Digay in Israa’iil iyo Taiwan Ay Khatar Ku Yihiin Jiritaanka iyo Qarannimada Dalka
articles.summary: Speaking at the groundbreaking ceremony for Somalia’s new National Defense University in Mogadishu on Sunday, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud issued a sharp warning that Israel and Taiwan threaten Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity through their direct engagement with Somaliland, while praising China as one of Mogadishu’s closest allies.
articles.summary_so: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maanta Muqdisho ka daah-furay dhismaha Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka ayaa si kulul u sheegay in Israa’iil iyo Taiwan ay khatar ku yihiin jiritaanka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya, isagoo dhinaca kale amaanay Shiinaha oo maalgelinaya mashruucaas.
articles.content:
Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud warned on Sunday that Israel and Taiwan pose a direct threat to Somalia’s existence and statehood, sharply escalating Mogadishu’s diplomatic pushback against foreign engagement with the breakaway region of Somaliland.
Addressing officials, military leaders, and Chinese Ambassador Wang Yu at a ceremony marking the launch of construction for Somalia’s National Defense University and an accompanying armed forces hospital in Mogadishu, the President drew a clear line between Somalia’s strategic partners and actors he accused of undermining national unity.
"Taiwan poses a threat to Somalia's existence, and Israel poses another threat to Somalia's statehood. We know who our close friends are, and who are not," President Mohamud declared during the event, which is being funded by China. Emphasizing self-reliance in national security, he added that a nation aspiring to depend on its own defense capabilities must first build the institutions and knowledge base that train its military leadership.
The remarks follow heightened diplomatic friction over Somaliland, which Israel has formally recognized and where Taiwan maintains an active representative office and bilateral cooperation programs in Hargeisa. Mogadishu views both relationships as violations of its sovereignty and territorial integrity, reinforcing Somalia’s alignment with Beijing’s "One China" policy while leaning on partners such as China and Türkiye to defend its borders.
During the same address—delivered shortly after returning from the COP31 UN climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye—President Mohamud also rebuked domestic opposition leaders for seeking external solutions to Somalia’s political disputes, urging them instead to return to national dialogue as the country braces for severe El Niño flooding projected to affect up to 3.4 million people in southern provinces.
articles.content_so:
Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta oo Axad ah magaalada Muqdisho ka sheegay in Israa’iil iyo Taiwan ay khatar toos ah ku yihiin jiritaanka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya, taasoo muujinaysa mowqifka adag ee Dowladda Federaalku ka taagan tahay xiriirka tooska ah ee lala yeesho Somaliland.
Isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabadda dhagax-dhigga Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka iyo isbitaalka ciidamada qalabka sida oo ay ka soo qayb galeen saraakiil sare iyo Safiirka Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya, Wang Yu, Madaxweynuhu wuxuu si cad u kala saaray saaxiibbada dhabta ah ee Soomaaliya iyo dhinacyada uu ku eedeeyay inay dhaawacayaan midnimada dalka.
"Taiwan waxay khatar ku tahay jiritaanka Soomaaliya, Israa’iilna waxay khatar kale ku tahay dowladnimada Soomaaliya. Waan naqaannaa cidda saaxiibkeenna dhow ah iyo cidda aan ahayn," ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isagoo xusay in Shiinuhu uu yahay mid ka mid ah saaxiibbada ugu dhow Soomaaliya isla markaana uu maalgelinayo dhismaha jaamacadda difaaca. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dal doonaya inuu isku tiirsanaado dhanka difaaca uu marka hore dhiso hay’adaha iyo aqoonta soo saarta hoggaankiisa ciidan.
Hadalka Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayso xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ee ka dhalatay aqoonsiga ay Israa’iil siisay Somaliland iyo joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed ee Taiwan ay ku leedahay magaalada Hargeysa, taasoo Muqdisho u aragto xad-gudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya.
Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo dhowaan ka soo laabtay shirka cimilada adduunka ee COP31 ee ka dhacay dalka Turkiga ayaa mucaaradka ku dhaliilay inay xal ka raadinayaan dibadda, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay ku soo laabtaan miiska wada-hadalka xilli dalku wajahayo digniin ku saabsan fatahaado xooggan oo El Niño ah oo saamayn kara ilaa 3.4 milyan oo qof oo ku nool gobollada koonfureed.

articles.title: If Somalia’s Leaders Cannot Compromise at Home, How Can They Lead a Nation?
articles.title_so: Faallada SGN: Haddii Siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya Ay Ku Heshiin Waayaan Miiska Wada-Hadalka, Sidee Loogu Aamini Karaa Xallinta Dhibaatooyinka Qaranka?
articles.summary: The collapse of the November 14 national dialogue in Mogadishu exposes a troubling reality: political elites who cannot agree on the basic terms of sitting across a table without foreign referees cannot be expected to solve Somalia’s existential challenges.
articles.summary_so: Fashilka ku yimid shirkii wada-tashiga qaran ee 14-ka Nofembar ee Muqdisho wuxuu banaanka soo dhigay xaqiiqo qadhaadh: hoggaamiyeyaal aan awoodin inay dhexdooda ka heshiiyaan shuruudaha wada-hadalka iyagoon u yeeran dhex-dhexaadiye shisheeye, ma xallin karaan masiirka iyo caqabadaha waaweyn ee horyaalla dalka.
articles.content:
Empty chairs at a scheduled national dialogue in Mogadishu have once again laid bare the paralysis gripping Somalia’s political class. As the country confronts an intensifying constitutional and electoral standoff—marked by disputed term extensions, clashes over judicial independence, and a boycott by major opposition blocs and dissenting federal member states—the failure to even open preliminary talks raises an urgent question for every Somali citizen.
If Somalia’s leaders cannot muster the political maturity to compromise on a meeting venue or an electoral framework without demanding foreign mediators to referee every step, how can the public trust them to solve the monumental crises facing the nation?
Somalia’s challenges are neither theoretical nor trivial. Millions of citizens are grappling with the persistent threat of Al-Shabaab, severe economic strain, recurring drought and displacement, and the unfinished work of building durable state institutions. Navigating these realities requires statesmanship, shared sacrifice, and a willingness to put national survival ahead of factional leverage.
Instead, both sides have locked themselves into a zero-sum stalemate. By insisting on unilateral timelines on one hand, or refusing to engage without external intervention on the other, political leaders reinforce the very dependency and division that have held Somalia back for decades. Foreign diplomats—whether from the Quartet or regional capitals—can facilitate a room, but they cannot manufacture patriotism, good faith, or national consensus.
Leadership is tested not when power is secure, but when compromise is required to prevent a national breakdown. Until Somalia’s political actors prove they can talk to one another as fellow citizens responsible for one country, their promises to rescue the nation will ring hollow.
articles.content_so:
Kuraasta maran ee fagaarihii loo asteeyay wada-tashiga qaran ee magaalada Muqdisho waxay mar kale muujiyeen curyaaminta siyaasadeed ee haysata hoggaanka dalka. Iyadoo Soomaaliya ay ku jirto khilaaf dastuuri ah iyo is-mari-waa doorasho oo ka dhashay muddo-kororsi lagu muransan yahay, khilaaf garsoor, iyo qaadacaad ay sameeyeen isbahaysiga mucaaradka iyo qaar ka mid ah maamul-goboleedyada, fashilka ku yimid in xitaa la furo wada-hadal horudhac ah wuxuu dhalinayaa su’aal muhiim ah oo hortaalla muwaadin kasta.
Haddii siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed—muxaafid iyo mucaaradba—ay ku heshiin waayaan goobta shirka iyo hannaanka doorashada iyagoon shuruud ka dhigin faragelin iyo dhex-dhexaadin shisheeye, sidee loogu aamini karaa inay xalliyaan dhibaatooyinka baaxadda leh ee haysta ummadda Soomaaliyeed?
Caqabadaha horyaalla Soomaaliya ma aha kuwo fudud. Shacabku wuxuu la tacaalayaa khatarta argagixisada Al-Shabaab, sicir-barar iyo dhaqaale xumo, abaaro soo noqnoqday, iyo baahida loo qabo dhismaha hay’ado dowladeed oo adag. Ka gudubka marxaladdan adag wuxuu u baahan yahay bisayl siyaasadeed, tanaasul, iyo in danta qaranka laga horumariyo loolanka kursiga.
Taa beddelkeeda, labada dhinacba waxay isku xireen mowqifyo adag oo aan isu soo dhowaanayn. Diblomaasiyiinta shisheeye waxay diyaarin karaan hoolka shirka, balse ma abuuri karaan waddaniyad, kalsooni, iyo heshiis qaran oo gudaha ka yimaada. Hoggaaminta dhabta ah waxaa lagu cabbiraa marka loo baahdo tanaasul badbaadiya qaranka; inta ay siyaasiyiinteennu ka weecsanayaan inay iyagu dhexdooda xal gaaraan, sheegashadooda ku aaddan inay dalka u adeegayaan waxay noqonaysaa mid aan lagu kalsoonaan karin.

articles.title: SGN Editorial: Sovereignty Is Non-Negotiable—Somalia Must Draw a Hard Line Against Foreign Interference
articles.title_so: Faallada SGN: Madax-Bannaanidu Gorgortan Ma Gasho—Soomaaliya Waa Inay Xiriirka U Jartaa Dal Walba oo Faragelin Wada
articles.summary: True independence means refusing to trade national dignity for external patronage. As foreign rivalries continue to fuel domestic divisions, Somalia must adopt an uncompromising diplomatic standard: respect our sovereignty, or lose your seat at the table.
articles.summary_so: Gobannimada dhabta ahi waa inaan sharafta qaranka lagu beddelan dano shisheeye. Iyadoo loolanka dalalka dibaddu uu sii hurinayo khilaafka gudaha, Soomaaliya waxaa la gudboon inay qaadato mowqif diblomaasiyadeed oo cad: ixtiraam qarannimadeenna, ama albaabka ka bax.
articles.content:
For too long, Somalia’s political landscape has been treated as an open chessboard for outside powers pursuing their own maritime, commercial, and security agendas. By bypassing the Federal Government in Mogadishu to strike unilateral deals with regional administrations and political factions, certain foreign actors have actively deepened internal fragmentation and slowed the rebuilding of state institutions.
A sovereign nation cannot move forward while allowing external capitals to dictate its internal politics or undermine its territorial integrity. Diplomatic partnerships must be built on mutual respect, international law, and recognition of a single, unified Somali state—not backroom leverage that pits Somalis against one another.
When foreign governments violate that basic principle, Mogadishu has both the right and the duty to cut ties, suspend agreements, and reorient its alliances toward partners who honor Somalia’s independence. Self-reliance begins with self-respect, and no amount of foreign aid or short-term political backing is worth sacrificing the sovereignty of the Somali Republic.
articles.content_so:
Muddo dheer, masraxa siyaasadda Soomaaliya waxaa loo arkayay fagaare ay quwado shisheeye ku fushadaan danahooda badda, ganacsiga, iyo amniga. Iyadoo la baal-marayo Dowladda Federaalka ee Muqdisho, heshiisyo gaar ahna lala gelayo maamullo iyo kooxo siyaasadeed, dalal dhowr ah ayaa si toos ah u sii kala qaybiyay ummadda Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana curyaamiyay dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha qaranka.
Dal madax-bannaan horumar ma gaari karo inta uu u oggol yahay caasimado shisheeye inay farageliyaan arrimihiisa gudaha ama ay dhaawacaan midnimadiisa dhuleed. Xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed waa inuu ku dhisnaadaa is-ixtiraam, sharciga caalamiga ah, iyo aqoonsiga hal dowlad oo midaysan—ee ma aha dano gaar ah oo Soomaalida la isugu adeegsado.
Marka ay dowlad shisheeye ku tumato mabda’aas aasaasiga ah, Xukuumadda Federaalka waxay xaq iyo waajib u leedahay inay xiriirka u jarto, laasho heshiisyada, oo ay u weecato saaxiibbo dhab ah oo xushmeeya gobannimada Soomaaliya. Is-ku-tiirsanaantu waxay ka bilaabataa is-ixtiraam, mana jirto kaalmo shisheeye oo u qalanta in lagu beddesho madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya.

articles.title: Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s Unfiltered Speech on Somalia’s State-Building Reality Draws Praise for Rare Political Candor
articles.title_so: Khudbaddii Geesinimada Lahayd ee Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse ee Ku Saabsanayd Jahada Dalka oo Lagu Amaanay Run-Sheegnimadeeda
articles.summary: Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s unusually blunt address warning Somalis to abandon political illusions and confront the fragility of the country’s state institutions has sparked widespread discussion, with many observers commending his rare willingness to speak openly about deep-rooted structural and tribal divisions.
articles.summary_so: Khudbaddii kululayd ee uu Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre kaga hadlay xaqiiqada dhabta ah ee dowladnimada Soomaaliya iyo baahida loo qabo in laga baxo khiyaaliga siyaasadeed ayaa dhalisay falcelin ballaaran, iyadoo dad badan ay ku amaaneen dhiirranaanta uu runta ugu sheegay bulshada iyo siyaasiyiinta.
articles.content:
In a political landscape often defined by diplomatic euphemisms and rehearsed talking points, Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s recent address on the direction of the country stood out for its striking candor. Calling on Somalis to face reality and step away from self-deception, the Prime Minister acknowledged openly that the current system still operates more as fragmented clan territories than a fully realized nation-state.
For many citizens and political observers weary of decades of stalled state-building, that level of honesty from the country’s top executive is both overdue and worth commending. Rather than painting an artificially rosy picture of institutional maturity, Hamza laid bare the core obstacles holding Somalia back: entrenched clan politics, protracted disputes between the federal government and regional member states, and a political culture that frequently prioritizes short-term leverage over long-term national cohesion.
By challenging political rivals and regional leaders to move beyond obstruction and engage in direct dialogue around elections, national security, and self-reliance, the Prime Minister framed Somalia’s crossroads in clear, unmistakable terms. His insistence that true governance cannot be built on illusions—and that Somalia requires bold, decisive leadership to break out of repetitive cycles of crisis—resonated with those who argue that diagnosing the problem honestly is the first step toward fixing it.
At the same time, observers note that the true test of the speech lies in whether this rare rhetorical honesty translates into tangible institutional reform, inclusive political consensus, and stronger accountability across the federal administration itself. Still, by refusing to sugarcoat the state of the nation, Prime Minister Hamza delivered a wake-up call that cuts to the heart of Somalia’s political reality.
articles.content_so:
Masraxa siyaasadda Soomaaliya oo inta badan lagu yaqaanno hadallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu qariyo xaqiiqooyinka qadhaadh, khudbaddii u dambaysay ee Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre waxay noqotay mid si gaar ah u soo jiidatay indhaha shacabka. Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu si aan gabbasho lahayn u sheegay in loo baahan yahay in runta loo yimaado lagana baxo khiyaaliga, isagoo qiray in dowladnimada maanta jirta ay weli ku dhex milan tahay qabyaalad iyo kala qaybsanaan.
Shacab badan iyo falanqeeyayaal muddo dheer ka daalay dib-u-dhaca ku yimid dhismaha qaranka ayaa u arka in run-sheegnimada noocan ah ee ka soo yeertay hoggaanka sare ee xukuumadda ay tahay tallaabo mudan in lagu amaano. Halkii uu sawir been ah ka bixin lahaa xaaladda dalka, Xamse wuxuu farta ku fiiqay caqabadaha rasmiga ah ee hortaagan horumarka Soomaaliya: qabyaaladda siyaasadaysan, khilaafka aan dhammaan ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah maamul-goboleedyada, iyo in amniga iyo dagaalka Al-Shabaab loo adeegsado gorgortan siyaasadeed.
Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu sidoo kale ugu baaqay mucaaradka iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda inay miiska wada-hadalka yimaadaan, isagoo xusay in kursigu yahay mid wareegto ah, tartankuna uu ku habboon yahay inuu ku dhaco sanduuqa doorashada halkii dalka la gelin lahaa hubanti la’aan. Hadalkiisa ku saabsan in Soomaaliya u baahan tahay "hoggaan ka duwan sidii hore" si looga baxo dhibaatada soo noqnoqotay ayaa taabtay dareenka dad badan oo aaminsan in daawaynta cudurku ay ka bilaabato in marka hore si dhab ah loo qiro.
Inkastoo dadka siyaasadda faaqida ay ku doodayaan in qiimaha dhabta ah ee khudbaddan lagu cabbiri doono sida xukuumaddu ay hadalladan ugu beddesho ficil, isla-xisaabtan, iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, haddana geesinimada uu Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse runta ugu sheegay bulshada waxay ahayd farriin cad oo ku soo aadday xilli xasaasi ah.

articles.title: Defense Minister Fiqi Under Fire After Accusing Opposition of Receiving Unproved $4 Million in Foreign Funds Amid Heightened Security Failures
articles.title_so: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Fiqi oo Lagu Eedeeyay Eedeymo aan Caddayn Lahayn oo uu u Jeediyay Mucaaradka, Isagoo Face-To-Face u Waajahaya Dhaleecayn ku saabsan Amniga oo Fashilmay
articles.summary: Political tensions in Somalia have flared following a series of unproven, high-stakes allegations by Defense Minister Ahmed Moalim Fiqi, who accused opposition leaders of taking $4 million in foreign funds to destabilize the government. Opponents and civil society have fiercely rejected the claims, pointing to a severe lack of evidence while calling the defense leadership “the most unqualified” to manage the country's armed forces during a chaotic, under-prepared security transition that has left Somali soldiers facing heavy casualties at the hands of Al-Shabaab.
articles.summary_so: Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa cirka isku shareeray kadib markii Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, uu mucaaradka ku eedeeyay inay helen $4 milyan oo dollar oo dibadda laga maalgeliyay si ay dalka u qasaan, eedeymahan oo aan loo hayn wax caddayn ah. Tani waxay dhalisay falcelin kulul, iyadoo mucaaradka iyo dadka faaqida siyaasadda ay wasiirka ku sifeeyeen qofka ugu habboonayn ee abid qabta xilkaas, xilli ciidanka qaranka ay wajahayaan dayacaad, hoggaan-xumo, iyo guuldarrooyin amni oo ka dhashay fashilka ku aaddan u-diyaar-garowga ka bixitaanka ciidamada shisheeye.
articles.content:
Somalia's Defense Minister, Ahmed Moalim Fiqi, has ignited a fierce political storm after publicly accusing opposition groups of a "dangerous plot" backed by $4 million in foreign funds—allegedly coordinated during meetings in Abu Dhabi—to undermine the federal government. Addressing local media, Fiqi warned that "an iron fist must be used against anyone organizing militias" and threatened to treat political rivals as "traitors" who will face severe consequences.
The explosive remarks, however, were notably devoid of any verifiable intelligence, bank records, or independently verified evidence. For an administration already grappling with deep divisions, the unsubstantiated accusations have been met with swift and furious pushback. Opposition leaders, clan elders, and independent analysts have dismissed Fiqi's claims as an attempt to distract the public from the administration’s own security failures.
"Defense Minister Fiqi is throwing wild accusations to cover up the fact that he is the most unqualified person to ever hold this critical portfolio," said an opposition representative, speaking on the condition of anonymity due to the tense political climate. "Instead of presenting facts, he uses the defense ministry to run a smear campaign against anyone who questions the government's military record."
Many critics are directing their anger not just at Fiqi, but at the broader leadership of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud (Hassan Hiraab). They point out that the administration has had more than four years of planning and international support to prepare the Somali National Army (SNA) for the withdrawal of foreign peacekeeping forces (AUSSOM/ATMIS). Yet, the transition has been marred by a lack of progress, leaving the army poorly equipped to handle the handovers.
While brave Somali soldiers face Al-Shabaab on the frontlines, their efforts are being undermined by what many see as a failure of leadership, systemic corruption, and political disputes in Mogadishu. Analysts highlight that resources like food, fuel, and ammunition are regularly siphoned off, leaving front-line troops without basic necessities. Because the government has failed to build sustainable holding forces to secure territory after initial offensives, fatigue and troop desertions have become widespread, leading to the loss of previously liberated towns in central and southern Somalia.
Rather than uniting the country to face Al-Shabaab, the defense ministry is being accused of prioritizing political survival over military readiness. "Our brave soldiers are paying with their lives for the incompetence in Mogadishu," said a retired military officer. "When the defense minister spends his time hunting political enemies instead of securing our borders and properly supplying our troops, the result is predictable: more deaths, lost ground, and an emboldened Al-Shabaab."
As the timeline for foreign troop withdrawals grows shorter, the lack of transparency, accountability, and cohesive leadership at the Ministry of Defense continues to undermine confidence in Somalia's transition to self-reliance, leaving the country's security and political future highly uncertain.
articles.content_so:
Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa kiciyay xiisad xooggan kadib markii uu warbaahinta ka sheegay in siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ay shirar abaabul ah oo dalka lagu wiiqayo ku yeesheen magaalada Abu Dhabi ee Imaaraadka Carabta, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay heleen lacag dhan $4 milyan oo dollar. Fiqi wuxuu ku hanjabay in "gacan bir ah" lagu qaban doono qof kasta oo isku daya inuu maleeshiyo abaabulo, isagoo ku tilmaamay qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta "khiyaano-qaran" oo wajahaya cawaaqib xun.
Hase yeeshee, eedeymahan culus ayaan la socon wax caddayn ah oo la taaban karo, sida baaritaanno madax-bannaan ama xog maaliyadeed oo la aamini karo. Tani waxay keentay in siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, odayaasha dhaqanka, iyo indheer-garatada ay ku gacan-sayraan hadalka wasiirka, iyagoo ku tilmaamay isku-day lagu weecinayo indhaha shacabka oo ku aaddan fashilka ballaaran ee dhanka amniga iyo difaaca dalka.
"Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Fiqi, wuxuu isku dayayaa inuu eedeymo been abuur ah ku qariyo inuu yahay shakhsigii ugu tabarta iyo aqoonta yaraa ee abid soo mara wasaaraddan muhiimka ah," ayuu yiri xildhibaan ka tirsan mucaaradka oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la sheegin sababo la xiriira amnigiisa. "Wuxuu wasaaraddii difaaca qaranka u adeegsanayaa inuu ku sumeeyo dadka ka duwan aragtida dowladda, halkii uu diiradda saari lahaa dagaalka Al-Shabaab."
Dhegeystayaal iyo falanqeeyayaal badan ayaa farta ku fiiqay hoggaanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud (Hassan Hiraab) iyo wasiirkiisa, iyagoo xusay in ka badan afar sano oo dowladda loogu talagalay inay ciidamada xoogga dalka ugu diyaariso sidii ay ula wareegi lahaayeen amniga guud marka ay baxaan ciidamada shisheeye ee ATMIS/AUSSOM, balse lagu guuldareystay.
In kasta oo ciidamada dhiirran ee Soomaaliyeed ay dhiiggooda u daadinayaan difaaca dalka, haddana waxaa si weyn loo dareemayaa hoggaan-xumo, musuqmaasuq dhanka saadka ah (sida raashinka, shidaalka iyo rasaasta oo la musuqmaaso), iyo khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo daciifiyay niyadda ciidanka. Arrimahan ayaa keenay in ciidanku waayaan taageero ku filan iyo qorshe rasmi ah oo lagu haysto dhulalkii la xoreeyay, taas oo keentay in Al-Shabaab ay dib u qabsadaan deegaanno badan oo horay looga saaray, iyadoo ay sii kordheen khasaaraha iyo dhimashada askarta Soomaaliyeed.
Halkii ay dowladda iyo wasaaradda gaashaandhigga xoogga saari lahaayeen dhisidda ciidan qaran oo hufan, waxay u muuqdaan inay ku mashquulsan yihiin dagaal siyaasadeed iyo cabsigelinta mucaaradka. "Ciidankeenna dhiirran waxay u dhimanayaan hoggaan-xumada iyo musuqa ka jira Muqdisho," ayuu yiri sarkaal hore oo ka tirsanaa milatariga. "Haddii wasiirka gaashaandhiggu uu waqtigiisa ku bixiyo la-dagaallanka mucaaradka, halkii uu askarta u raadin lahaa agab iyo hoggaan sax ah, natiijadu waxay noqonaysaa dhimasho iyo dib-u-dhac."
Xilli uu sii dhowaanayo waqtiga ka-bixitaanka ciidamada shisheeye, kalsooni-darrada dhalatay iyo isla-xisaabtan la'aanta ka jirta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay halis weyn ku tahay mustaqbalka iyo xasilloonida dalka Soomaaliya.

articles.title: DOJ Dropped Charges Against Ilhan Omar’s Former Bodyguard After Effort to Turn Him Into an Informant Failed, Attorney Says
articles.title_so: Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka Oo Tuurtay Dacwad Ka Dhan Ahayd Ilaaliyihii Hore Ee Ilhan Omar Kadib Markii Uu Diiday Inuu Noqdo Basaas
articles.summary: Federal prosecutors indicted a Somali national who briefly worked as a security guard for U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar and spent months attempting to pressure him into testifying against the Minnesota Democrat before abruptly dropping the case in September, according to court records and the man’s defense attorney.
articles.summary_so: Dacwad-oogayaasha federaalka Mareykanka ayaa bishii Abriil dacwad dembi ah ku soo oogay muwaadin Soomaali ah oo muddo kooban ilaalo u ahaa Xildhibaan Ilhan Omar, iyagoo isku dayay inay ku cadaadiyaan inuu xog ka bixiyo xildhibaanadda ka hor inta aysan kiiska ka laaban bishii Sebteembar, sida uu sheegay qareenkiisa.
articles.content:
A criminal immigration case brought earlier this year against Abdullahi Mohamud Mohamed, who briefly served as a bodyguard for Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar, has sparked sharp scrutiny over federal prosecutorial tactics in Washington and Minneapolis.
In April 2026, a federal grand jury indicted Mohamed on a Class D felony charge—carrying a maximum penalty of five years in prison—alleging that he lied under oath during his green card application process by answering "no" when asked whether he had ever worked for or interacted with American politicians.
According to Mohamed’s longtime Minneapolis defense attorney, Bruce Rivers, Mohamed was not fluent in English and misunderstood the phrasing of the interview question. More significantly, Rivers alleged that federal investigators and prosecutors used the felony indictment and deportation threat as leverage over several months in an attempt to recruit Mohamed as a cooperating informant against Omar.
Rivers stated that prosecutors repeatedly told him and his client that the broader inquiry into Omar’s family and citizenship history was "100 percent being run by 1600 Pennsylvania Ave," and pressed Mohamed for information regarding her marriages and background. "I've never seen anything like this in my almost 28 years practicing law in federal court," Rivers said.
Legal observers also questioned the foundation of the prosecution. Ryan Wood, a former federal prosecutor and senior immigration judge in Minnesota, described pursuing a criminal false-statement indictment over an answer given during a green card interview as "all but unheard-of," adding that offering immigration relief in exchange for cooperation would have rendered any resulting testimony legally compromised.
The Department of Justice denied any connection between the indictment and broader political inquiries, stating that the charges against Mohamed were "completely unrelated to any current investigations".
After Mohamed was brought to Washington to testify before a grand jury—where Rivers said his client reiterated that he had no incriminating information to share—prosecutors moved the following day in September 2026 to dismiss the indictment. In court filings, the government wrote that "there is no longer a federal interest in continuing prosecution in light of his anticipated removal from the United States". Mohamed subsequently left the United States, leaving behind his wife, a nursing student.
News of the dismissed case surfaced in November 2026 shortly after Omar won re-election to a fifth term in Minnesota’s Fifth Congressional District and amid heightened federal scrutiny of her family’s immigration history. A spokesperson for Omar condemned the targeting of Mohamed as a "blatant weaponization of the full federal government to intimidate political opponents".
articles.content_so:
Kiis la xiriira arrimaha socdaalka oo horraantii sanadkan lagu soo oogay Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Maxamed, oo muddo kooban ilaalo u soo noqday Xildhibaan Ilhan Omar oo laga soo doorto gobolka Minnesota, ayaa dhaliyay dood culus oo ku saabsan hab-dhaqanka dacwad-oogayaasha federaalka.
Bishii Abriil 2026, xeer-beegti federaal ah ayaa Cabdullaahi ku soo oogtay dacwad ciqaabeed oo xukunkeedu gaari karo ilaa shan sano oo xarig ah, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay inuu been u sheegay saraakiisha socdaalka xilligii uu dalbanayay deganaanshaha rasmiga ah (Green Card), kadib markii uu "maya" kaga jawaabay su'aal ahayd inuu la shaqeeyay siyaasiyiin Mareykan ah.
Qareenka difaacayay Cabdullaahi, Bruce Rivers, ayaa sheegay in macmiilkiisu uusan si fiican ugu hadlin luqadda Ingiriiska isla markaana uusan fahmin su'aasha la weydiiyay. Rivers wuxuu intaas ku daray in dacwad-oogayaashu ay bilo badan isku dayayeen inay xarigga iyo tarxiilka u adeegsadaan sidii ay Cabdullaahi uga dhigi lahaayeen basaas markhaati fura baaritaanka lagu hayo Ilhan Omar iyo qoyskeeda.
Sida uu sheegay qareenka, saraakiisha dacwadda waday ayaa si cad ugu sheegay in baaritaanka ka dhanka ah Ilhan Omar si toos ah looga hagayo Aqalka Cad. Dhankeeda, Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo sheegtay in dacwaddii Cabdullaahi aysan wax xiriir ah la lahayn baaritaanno kale oo socda.
Kadib markii Cabdullaahi la geeyay Washington si uu uga hor marag-furo xeer-ilaaliyaasha—halkaas oo qareenkiisu sheegay inuu ku celiyay inuusan haynin wax xog ah oo ka dhan ah Ilhan Omar—dacwad-oogayaashu waxay maalintii xigtay ee bishii Sebteembar codsadeen in kiiska la tuuro, iyagoo sabab uga dhigay in la filayo in dalka laga saaro. Cabdullaahi ayaa intaas kadib ka baxay Mareykanka, isagoo halkaas kaga tagay xaaskiisa oo ah ardayad barata culuumta caafimaadka.
Xafiiska Xildhibaan Ilhan Omar ayaa cambaareeyay tallaabada lagu beegsaday ilaaliyaheedii hore, iyadoo afhayeen u hadlay uu ku tilmaamay "adeegsi cad oo awoodda dowladda federaalka lagu cabsi-gelinayo dadka siyaasad ahaan ka soo horjeeda maamulka".

articles.title: Between Scorched Earth and Rising Waters: Somalia Confronts Relentless Climate Shocks as Millions Face Hunger and COP31 Finance Push
articles.title_so: U Dhexeeya Abaar Iyo Daadad: Isbeddelka Cimilada Oo Halis Geliyay Nolosha Malaayiin Soomaali Ah Xilli Dowladda Ay Ka Qayb-Galayso Shirka COP31
articles.summary: Caught in a punishing cycle of back-to-back droughts and destructive El Niño-driven floods, Somalia is enduring one of the world’s sharpest climate emergencies—pushing more than 5.4 million people toward acute hunger even as Mogadishu appeals for $11.1 billion in international climate financing at the COP31 summit in Türkiye.
articles.summary_so: Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa mid ka mid ah masiibooyinka cimilada ugu daran caalamka, kadib markii abaaro daba-dheeraaday ay si degdeg ah uga daba yimaadeen daadad ka dhashay roobabka El Niño, taasoo gaajo ba’an ku ridday in ka badan 5.4 milyan oo qof xilli dowladdu ay shirka COP31 ka dalbanayso 11.1 bilyan oo doollar.
articles.content:
For millions of Somali farmers, pastoralists, and displaced families, climate change is not a distant projection—it is a daily struggle for survival measured in failed rainy seasons and overflowing riverbanks. Ranked among the nations most vulnerable to global warming despite contributing a negligible fraction of global emissions, Somalia is locked in an extreme weather whiplash that leaves communities no time to recover between disasters.
Following consecutive failed rainy seasons that withered crops and decimated livestock herds, heavy October and November rains supercharged by the 2026–2027 El Niño cycle have unleashed severe flash and riverine flooding across central and southern regions. Already, nearly 170,000 people have been impacted by early floodwaters that have submerged farmland, washed out vital transit corridors, and forced families from their homes. Humanitarian agencies warn that up to 874,000 people face potential displacement as the deyr rainy season intensifies.
The environmental toll is directly fueling a deepening food and public health emergency. Between October and December 2026, an estimated 5.4 million Somalis are projected to face Crisis levels of hunger or worse, with more than 26,000 teetering on the edge of catastrophic famine. Contaminated floodwaters have simultaneously heightened the risk of waterborne diseases—compounding ongoing outbreaks of cholera, measles, and diphtheria—while unprecedented global humanitarian aid cuts have forced the closure of critical nutrition and health clinics across the country.
Beyond the immediate humanitarian toll, climate stress is reshaping Somalia’s social and security landscape. Shrinking water tables and degraded grazing lands intensify local competition over wells and pasture, while mass displacement swells overcrowded informal settlements around Mogadishu and Baidoa. Armed groups routinely exploit economic desperation and service vacuums in drought- and flood-stricken districts, complicating both relief delivery and state-building efforts.
